title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Standard and Basic licensed devices in the Pro Management portal
summary: The briefing passes: the licence requirements, assignment control, roadmap facts and automatic enrollment are supported, and the uncertainty about enforcement is appropriately narrow. Minor corrections would complete the inventory path and acknowledge differing Microsoft documentation about DoD portal access.

claims.claim: The Pro Management portal now supports Standard and Basic licensed Teams Rooms on Windows devices.
claims.quote: The Teams Rooms Pro Management portal now supports and enforces licenses for devices in Teams Rooms on Windows with a Standard or Basic license.

claims.fix: Complete controls[1].ui.path and the corresponding table path as 'Planning > Inventory > resource account > License Type', where resource account means finding the account assigned to the device, not opening another pane. The current route stops on the correct inventory page.
